LAW & MOTION/DISCOVERY, DEPT. 301, AS TO APRIL-08-2025 HEARING RE: PETITIONER AMANDA CALDERON PINEDA'S MOTION TO COMPEL ARBITRATION; THE COURT ADOPTS ITS TENTATIVE RULING. PETITIONER/CLAIMANT AMANDA ZUYAMI CALDERON PINEDA'S PETITION TO COMPEL ARBITRATION IS GRANTED, BUT THE COURT STAYS THE COMMENCEMENT OR ARBITRATION UNTIL THE OCCUPATIONAL ACCIDENT INSURANCE (OAI) BENEFITS ARE DETERMINED AND EXHAUSTED (SEE MINI MINUTES FOR COMPLETE RULING). DEFENDANT IS TO PREPARE AND SUBMIT A PROPOSED ORDER WHICH REPEATS VERBATIM THE SUBSTANTIVE PORTION OF THE COURT'S RULING, WITH A COVER LETTER REFLECTING COMPLIANCE WITH CRC 3.1312. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: V. DA FONSECA; NOT REPORTED. =(301/CVA)
